from pathlib import Path
program_dir=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL-prime-agent-luna6-medium-fresh0/frozen/held-out-reference/play/users/u024/system/state/workspace/programs')
program_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
source='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # The full grid lines identify the colored separators.
    line_color = None
    row_seps = []
    col_seps = []
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        if row[0] != 0 and all(v == row[0] for v in row):
            row_seps.append(r)
            line_color = row[0]
    for c in range(w):
        v = grid[0][c]
        if v != 0 and all(row[c] == v for row in grid):
            col_seps.append(c)
            line_color = v if line_color is None else line_color
    def regions(size, seps):
        result = []
        start = 0
        for s in seps:
            if start < s:
                result.append((start, s))
            start = s + 1
        if start < size:
            result.append((start, size))
        return result
    rb = regions(h, row_seps)
    cb = regions(w, col_seps)
    for r0, r1 in rb:
        for j in range(0, len(cb) - 1, 2):
            c0, c1 = cb[j]
            d0, d1 = cb[j + 1]
            if r1-r0 != r1-r0 or c1-c0 != d1-d0:
                continue
            left = [[grid[r][c] for c in range(c0,c1)] for r in range(r0,r1)]
            right = [[grid[r][c] for c in range(d0,d1)] for r in range(r0,r1)]
            has_left = any(v != 0 for row in left for v in row)
            has_right = any(v != 0 for row in right for v in row)
            if has_left == has_right:
                continue
            src = left if has_left else right
            dest0 = d0 if has_left else c0
            for i in range(r1-r0):
                for k in range(c1-c0):
                    out[r0+i][dest0+k] = src[i][c1-c0-1-k]
    return out
'''
# fix harmless tautological condition in source
source=source.replace('if r1-r0 != r1-r0 or c1-c0 != d1-d0:', 'if c1-c0 != d1-d0:')
path=program_dir/'task-1650d300.py'
path.write_text(source)
exec(compile(source,str(path),'exec'),globals())
print('written',path)
